"""In-memory deletions of only the changed rebase integration behavior."""
import ast
import inspect
import os


def pytest_collection_modifyitems(session, config, items):
    from gpuwrf.optimize import cloud_controls, continuous

    mode = os.environ["V45_RES_MUTANT"]
    module, name = (cloud_controls, "cloud_arm") if mode == "R7_PDF" else (continuous, "driver")
    tree = ast.parse(inspect.getsource(getattr(module, name)))

    class Delete(ast.NodeTransformer):
        count = 0

        def visit_DictComp(self, node):
            self.generic_visit(node)
            if mode == "R7_PDF" and isinstance(node.value, ast.IfExp):
                node.generators[0].ifs.append(ast.parse('k != "bl_mynn_cloudpdf"', mode="eval").body)
                self.count += 1
            return node

        def visit_Expr(self, node):
            if (mode == "R5_WAVE" and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call)
                    and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Attribute)
                    and isinstance(node.value.func.value, ast.Name)
                    and node.value.func.value.id == "waves" and node.value.func.attr == "complete"):
                self.count += 1
                return ast.copy_location(ast.Pass(), node)
            return self.generic_visit(node)

    transform = Delete()
    tree = transform.visit(tree)
    assert transform.count == 1, (mode, transform.count)
    ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
    namespace = dict(vars(module))
    exec(compile(tree, "<resolution-deletion>", "exec"), namespace)
    setattr(module, name, namespace[name])

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows = []
targets = {
    "R7_PDF": "tests/w45_cloudknobs/test_cloud_controls.py::test_admitted_pdf_arm_overrides_the_inherited_case_variant",
    "R5_WAVE": "tests/w45_cloudknobs/test_wave_integration.py",
}
for mode, target in targets.items():
    if Path("/tmp/wrf_gpu2_quiet").exists():
        print("QUIET", flush=True)
        sys.exit(3)
    env = dict(os.environ, JAX_PLATFORMS="cpu", GPUWRF_JAX_CACHE="0", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
               V45_RES_MUTANT=mode, PYTHONPATH=str(root))
    log = root / f"{mode}.log"
    xml = root / f"{mode}.xml"
    start = time.monotonic()
    with log.open("w") as output:
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-p", "resolution_mutations", target,
                                 "--basetemp", f"<USER_HOME>/wrf_gpu2_lanes/v45-cloudknobs/pytest-stack-{mode}",
                                 "-q", "--tb=short", f"--junitxml={xml}"],
                                cwd=root/"snapshot", env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=300)
    suite = ET.parse(xml).getroot()
    failures, errors, skips = (list(suite.iter(tag)) for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped"))
    assert result.returncode == 1 and failures and not errors and not skips, (mode, result.returncode)
    assert all("assert" in f.attrib.get("message", "").lower() or "assertionerror" in (f.text or "").lower()
               for f in failures), [f.attrib for f in failures]
    row = dict(mode=mode, source="4bdab52979", target=target, rc=result.returncode,
               failures=len(failures), errors=len(errors), skips=len(skips), wall_s=time.monotonic()-start,
               classification="genuine assertion kill", xml=str(xml), log=str(log))
    rows.append(row)
    (root/"RESOLUTION_MUTANTS.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
